# learning-materials

HAXcms is a file-based CMS: authored pages and metadata are stored as portable files, not locked into a database-only workflow.
The canonical site structure is `site.json`, represented in JSON Outline Schema (`id`, `parent`, `order`, `slug`, `location`, and `metadata`).
Use HAX CLI and ecosystem tooling to maintain human-authored content while keeping machine-readable outputs synchronized.
Managed files (feeds, search indexes, manifests, and this `llms.txt`) are generated artifacts and should be rebuilt by tooling.

## Core resources
- [site.json](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/site.json): Canonical site manifest and navigation tree in JSON Outline Schema format.
- [llms.txt](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/llms.txt): LLM-oriented guide to this site and its machine-readable resources.

## Pages
- [Welcome to learning-materials](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/pages/item-7cab202c-92ec-4555-a7a8-d6a1474198d7/index.md)
- [Lessons](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/pages/item-feb8ff9c-1368-4baf-b09c-6bb28d13d26c/index.md): Lessons group lectures, tutorials and exercises around a set of learning objectives.
- [Animation Principles](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/pages/item-cbfc6006-4b80-4af9-bfbc-db949b620459/index.md): Learn the twelve principles of animation and how to apply them to create believable movement in 3D animation.[object Object]
- [Exercises](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/pages/item-c7dc2be9-d558-4395-ac0b-794d400acc24/index.md): Formative practice focused on a narrow set of competencies.

## Optional
- [Search index](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/lunrSearchIndex.json): Lunr corpus for quick full-text retrieval.
- [RSS feed](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/rss.xml): Site updates in RSS format.
- [Atom feed](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/atom.xml): Site updates in Atom format.
- [Sitemap](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/sitemap.xml): URL-level discovery map for the published site.
- [Agent skills](https://localhost:3000/learning-materials/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index (agentskills.io v0.2.0) listing skills that teach an agent how to read, author, audit, and remix this site.
